text: The July Revolution of 2024 was a defining chapter in Bangladesh's history. It began with students asking for fairness and rapidly became a nationwide uprising that demanded freedom and justice. Through curfews, violence, and uncertainty, the resilience of the people shone through. In this experience, you will live through these tumultuous days as three ordinary individuals. Please note that while inspired by true events, the characters and specific scenarios are fictional composites intended to honor the spirit of the revolution.
